newsitem.title: UK: UK unemployment falls 18,400 in May.
newsitem.headline: UK unemployment falls 18,400 in May.

text.p: Unemployment in Britain fell by 18,400 to 1.64 million in May or 5.8 percent of the workforce, official figures showed on Wednesday.
The fall was less than analysts had expected.
Statistics also showed that average earnings increased by 4.5 percent in the year to April, unchanged from the previous month.
Sterling dipped against the dollar and the mark after the less-than-forecast unemployment data which showed the 15th consecutive monthly fall.
Analysts said the figures dampened expectations of another interest rate rise.
Philip Shaw of Union Plc said: "The smaller than expected monthly decline in unemployment should help to allay some fears about the labour market tightening."
